description:
From [Pocket Comics](https://www.mangaupdates.com/groups.html?id=10140796635):  
Reeling from her latest failed relationship, Jungin curses the god of fate for matching her with such terrible men. Unbeknownst to her, the god of fate is listening, and so is his unimpressed father. Exasperated by his son's incompetence, he banishes him to Earth until he is able to make up for his matchmaking mistakes.

**Original Webtoon:**  
[Naver Series](https://series.naver.com/comic/detail.series?productNo=6742962), [KakaoPage](https://page.kakao.com/content/58362183), [MrBlue](https://www.mrblue.com/webtoon/wt_000058073)
